messages:
Mia (Growth): ok team — upcoming webinar launch next Tue. we need search + retarget setup + a small creative refresh. goal: signups -> qualified leads. CPA target $45. :rocket:
Jon (Ads): copying briefs. planning 2 search ad sets (high intent + branded), and a dynamic retargeting pool for site visitors last 7d. starting daily budget = $1k for first 3 days, then flex. any objections?
Sarah (PM): sounds good. can we reserve 25% of spend for retargeting after day 1? want to keep initial funnel feeding.
Jon (Ads): yep. plan: day0-day1 = 75% search / 25% retarget. day2+ we'll shift to 65/35 if CPL stable. I will set automated pacing rules.
Marta (Creative): I'll push 3 refreshed creatives A/B:
```
1) Headline A: "Ship faster with Redwood Inference"
2) Headline B: "Cut token cost, keep output quality"
3) Headline C: "Production-ready LLM inference — hands-off scaling"
```
Mia (Growth): include creative variants that call out webinar time + CTA: "Save my spot". Also need 2 landing variants (short form + long form).
Alex (Analytics): tracking checklist: GA4 event 'webinar_signup', server-side webhook to HubSpot, and a custom UTM setup. I'll also add a conversion window of 7 days.
Lena (Sales Ops): for inbound routing — tag leads with `paid_webinar` + `creative_variant` and route to SDR queue A for high-intent (UTM_term present) else SDR queue B. Also, please ensure HubSpot property 'lead_score' is populated.
Jon (Ads): adding naming conventions and UTM we should use: 
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_may24&utm_content={creative_variant}&utm_term={keyword}
ad_name: WS_May24_Search_{audience}_{creativeShort}
retarget_name: WS_May24_Retarget_7d_{creativeShort}
```
Sarah (PM): frequency caps for retargeting? we don't want ad fatigue but need coverage.
Jon (Ads): set frequency to 3/day initially, cap creative rotation to 90% eligible impressions on rotating creatives. we'll monitor CTR and swap C if underperforming.
Mia (Growth): Alex — can you add an event that flags 'high intent' when utm_term OR landing form has company size >50? tag in payload to HubSpot.
Alex (Analytics): yep. will add attribute `high_intent:true` on webhook when conditions met. sending spec in DM.
Marta (Creative): quick ask — which creative performs best will determine the webinar slide variant. can you commit to turning around slide pack if A wins?
Sarah (PM): yes, we'll have a condensed slide deck ready for A and B. keep Marta posted.
Jon (Ads): launching draft campaigns later today in paused mode. ad-bot will post when campaigns are scheduled.
ad-bot: Campaigns for WS_May24_* created (paused). Job ID: 89734. Use `/ads launch 89734` to go live.
Mia (Growth): perfect. last things: UTM example for creative A: 
```
https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_may24&utm_content=creativeA&utm_term=llm+inference
```
Lena (Sales Ops): also add HubSpot workflow: urgent if `high_intent:true` -> notify SDR via Slack channel #sdr-inbox and send SMS to on-call rep.
Jon (Ads): will set day0 CPA cap $60, then tighten to $45 after n=30 conversions.
Mia (Growth): timeline recap: today - setup paused campaigns + tracking. tomorrow - smoke test and landing QA. Tue - 9am launch. Monitor hourly first 6 hours.
Sarah (PM): I'll run the launch checklist and post status here 30m before go.
Marta (Creative): uploading creatives to shared drive now. links in thread once done.
Alex (Analytics): I'll publish the dashboard and a realtime alert for CPL > $80.
Mia (Growth): outstanding owners: Jon = ads launch/pacing, Alex = tracking/alerts, Lena = lead routing, Marta = creatives, Sarah = launch ops. thanks all :thumbsup:
Jon (Ads): cool — schedule set. ping me if we need emergency pause.
Lena (Sales Ops): noted. will prep SDR playbook for qualifying webinar leads.
ad-bot: Campaign 89734 moved from paused -> active by Jon (Ads).
Mia (Growth): excellent. let's keep updates short in this thread only.
